name: Botaz (Brian Aviles)
notes: Art Director and Graphic Designer based in Brooklyn, NY. Handled most of BREAD's creative and graphic design work. Co-founded TRASH CVLT (Oakland queer artist collective/warehouse rave culture). Clients include Linkin Park, Madonna, Red Hott Chili Peppers, Kerry Washington, Meghan Trainor, YouTube, Ancestry, Vresh. Agencies: Monks (2023–2024), XX Artists (2021–2023), Quantasy (2020–2021).
